definitions.explanation: The point in the tidal cycle when the sea level is at its highest. The native ({訓読|くんよ}み) reading of {満潮|まんちょう}.

examples.english: The waves are high at high tide.
At high tide, these rocks become submerged in the sea.

notes:
{満潮|みちしお} is the native (⟦{訓読|くんよ}み→訓読み：10454_kunyomi⟧) reading of {満潮|まんちょう}, both meaning high tide. The native reading is common in everyday and poetic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {満潮|みちしお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: the tide comes in
- {満潮|みちしお}⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧: at high tide

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{潮|しお}→引き潮：07148_hikishio⟧: low tide — the opposite, native reading
- {満潮|まんちょう}: high tide — same kanji, Sino-Japanese reading, more technical
